assessment.rationale: Robotic solar installation exists only at pilot and early commercial scale, far from the Main KPI of 1,000,000 MW installed by robots per year (more than all solar installed worldwide: about 647-698 GW in 2025, https://www.pv-tech.org/global-solar-pv-installations-reached-647gw-in-2025/). The leading robots still work with human crews: AES Maximo installed 100 MW at Bellefield by March 2026 (https://www.pv-tech.org/youre-going-to-see-a-lot-more-of-these-maximo-on-robotic-installation-utility-scale-solar-projects/); Terabase Terafab V2 finished field testing in 2026 with a rated output of about 1 GW per line-year and autonomous rovers still promised (https://www.terabase.energy/resources/terabase-energys-next-generation-terafab-completes-field-testing-ready-for-deployment); Built Robotics' autonomous pile driver runs with a two-person crew (https://www.builtrobotics.com/press/the-elusive-dream-of-fully-autonomous-construction-vehicles). No open-source end-to-end crewless system was found; Luminous has announced an open construction dataset only. Honest limit: module pick-and-place, autonomous piling and field-factory assembly are commercial prior art; tasks must target the unsolved parts (crewless site prep, trenching, electrical termination, QA, and generalising across terrain) with their own prior-art basis.

additionalSearches.query: AES Atlas solar installation robot 2026 deployment megawatts installed by robots
additionalSearches.finding: AES Maximo robots installed 100 MW at the 1 GW Bellefield project by March 2026; company claims about 2x speed. Pilot-scale relative to the KPI.

additionalSearches.query: Terabase Terafab automated solar construction Sarcos Built Robotics solar pile driving autonomous 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Terafab V2 completed field testing March 2026 after five first-generation deployments; about 1 GW per factory-year; rovers 'soon' fully autonomous.

additionalSearches.query: global annual solar PV installations 2025 GW total
additionalSearches.finding: Global PV additions in 2025 were about 647 GW (Ember), 664 GW (SolarPower Europe) or 698 GW (IEA PVPS); the KPI exceeds all installation worldwide.

additionalSearches.query: fully autonomous solar farm construction without human crew robot open source
additionalSearches.finding: No open-source crewless solar construction system; Built Robotics RPD 35 needs a two-person crew; Charge Robotics claims a fully autonomous system, unverified.
